title: Korean BBQ Beef Ssam
description: A flavorful Korean-inspired dish featuring marinated beef and crispy kimchi in a crispy rice wrapper.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together ssamjang, garlic, ginger, and sesame oil.
Add the sliced beef to the marinade and toss to coat.
Grill the beef for 3-4 minutes per side, or until cooked to desired level of doneness.
Meanwhile, toast the rice wrappers on the grill or in a dry pan for 30 seconds.
Assemble the ssam by placing a lettuce leaf on a flat surface, followed by a slice of beef, a spoonful of kimchi, and a sprinkle of sesame seeds and green onion.
Fold the bottom half of the lettuce up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll up the ssam to form a tight cylinder.
Note: For a vegetarian version, substitute the beef with marinated and grilled portobello mushrooms.
